title: 2002 AMC 10A Problem 20
statement: Points \(A,\) \(B,\) \(C,\) \(D,\) \(E,\) and \(F\) lie, in that order, on \(\overline{AF},\) dividing it into five segments, each of length \(1.\) Point \(G\) is not on line \(AF.\) Point \(H\) lies on \(\overline{GD},\) and point \(J\) lies on \(\overline{GF}.\) The line segments \(\overline{HC},\) \(\overline{JE},\) and \(\overline{AG}\) are parallel. Find \(\frac{HC}{JE}.\)

solutions.text:
Since \(HC\parallel AG,\) \(\triangle DHC\sim\triangle DGA,\) so \(\dfrac{HC}{AG}=\dfrac{DC}{DA}=\dfrac{1}{3},\) giving \(HC=\dfrac{AG}{3}.\)

Since \(JE\parallel AG,\) \(\triangle FJE\sim\triangle FGA,\) so \(\dfrac{JE}{AG}=\dfrac{FE}{FA}=\dfrac{1}{5},\) giving \(JE=\dfrac{AG}{5}.\)

Therefore \(\dfrac{HC}{JE}=\dfrac{\frac{AG}{3}}{\frac{AG}{5}}=\dfrac{5}{3}.\)

Thus, the correct answer is D.
hints: \(\triangle DHC\sim\triangle DGA\) gives \(HC\) in terms of \(AG\)
\(\triangle FJE\sim\triangle FGA\) gives \(JE\) in terms of \(AG\)
